definitions.explanation: Chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart muscle, typically due to narrowed coronary arteries. Often triggered by exertion or stress.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{狭心症|きょうしんしょう}を{患|わずら}っている。
{階段|かいだん}を{上|のぼ}ると{狭心症|きょうしんしょう}の{発作|ほっさ}が{起|お}きる。
examples.english: Going up stairs brings on an angina attack.

examples.japanese: {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}は{放置|ほうち}しておくと{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}に{進行|しんこう}する{危険|きけん}がある。
examples.english: If left untreated, angina carries a risk of progressing to a heart attack.

notes:
Compound of {狭|きょう} (narrow) + {心|しん} (heart) + {症|しょう} (illness, condition). Refers to the symptom complex caused by narrowed coronary arteries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}の{発作|ほっさ}: angina attack
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}を{患|わずら}う: to suffer from angina
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}の{治療|ちりょう}: treatment for angina

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}: myocardial infarction; heart attack — when a coronary artery is completely blocked; more severe than {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}
- {心臓発作|しんぞうほっさ}: heart attack (colloquial) — non-medical umbrella term covering both
